1. Booking and Confirmation

Drivers will arrive at the agreed pickup point at the designated time. Standard airport pickup includes 60 minutes free waiting time after flight touchdown.

3. Payment Terms

Payment can be made in cash (IDR), bank transfer, or QRIS upon arrival as agreed during WhatsApp consultation.
